title: MEIKO — A Quality Blend〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Humhum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You look like you're having fun, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, hello, Miku.
Welcome to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't remember asking for any help today, so are you here as a customer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. But you're in the midst of something, right? Anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You want to help?
That'd be great.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... What're you doing, anyway?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorting out the coffee beans while there's still no one in the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There will always be a few beans that are not in the best of conditions when you buy them from a shop.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Keeping these damaged beans will affect the taste of the coffee that you brew.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, you really know a lot.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It was written on the label of the bag of beans I bought. Wasn't it nice of them to warn us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you just read what was on the label...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How do you pick out the damaged beans, though?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You spread the beans out like this and split them up into usable and unusable beans.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But there are so many beans!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not as hard as it looks. For example, see this whitish bean here? That's not usable. Easy to spot, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right. The color's completely different.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See? And then there's the opposite—overly dark beans.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's not usable too... It's really quite easy to tell if you look closely enough.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. So, can you help me with this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... Can you pick out the white beans and beans that are of a different size than usual?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I can do that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Let's make delicious coffee together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mhm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is really boring work, huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, you could say that again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there's a big difference between the coffee brewed from before and after doing this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it really that big?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. And don't you want these unroasted beans to become a delicious pot of coffee? Especially since it would only take a little effort on your part?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I would rather have something more delicious than not if I can help it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I also make coffee for myself, you know.
Not just for customers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I use my own personal special blend.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehehe, that's the perk of being a cafe owner, right? At least let me have that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well... As long as the coffee you serve to customers always tastes good, I guess that's fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're so sweet. I'll treat you to my special blend later, to thank you for helping out!
